turns.prompt_text: I'm in Google Maps and I made a bunch of different saved locations. I put some notes in them detailing information I would like to use. Now that I look at them again, I can't find this information.
turns.response_html:
To view notes attached to saved places:

  1. Open Google Maps and tap the Saved (or You) tab at the bottom.
  2. Select the specific list (e.g., Favorites or Want to go).
  3. Scroll down through the list to view your saved places; notes appear directly beneath each location name.

Alternatively, search keywords from your notes using the search bar at the top of the Saved tab. Notes do not show up when clicking pins directly on the map view.
